The '''All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally''' was a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] event organized around [[3626 BBY]]. It occurred on several [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Held after the [[Dantooine Incursion]], the Swoop Rally was hosted by [[B4-N9]], an intense [[Droid/Legends|droid]] announcer built by [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] enthusiasts.<ref name="Swoop-Dantooine" /> Audience members consisted of members of various [[Species/Legends|species]], some of whom set up camp sites around the rally. On Dantooine, campers had charred [[Kath hound/Legends|kath hound]] shanks for [[Foodstuff/Legends|sustenance]].<ref name="Dantooine">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=location|Dantooine}}</ref>
